summary: Biddance AI Systems, Inc., a Xiamen-based foreign private issuer listed on Nasdaq, furnished a Form 6-K on October 8, 2026, disclosing a change of its ticker symbol for Class A ordinary shares to 'BDAI' from 'HKIT,' effective at the open of trading on October 9, 2026. The filing contains no transaction, no terms, no board recommendation and no advisor. It is a routine corporate-administrative notice incorporated by reference into existing Form F-3 and S-8 registration statements. No special-situation or risk-arb angle is presented; watch only for any future corporate action accompanying the rebrand.
